title: Children of Heavenly Father
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: Baby John grew up to be John the Baptist. Heavenly Father sent him with a job to do.
John’s job was to tell everyone about the Light, and the Light is Jesus. John was not the Light. He pointed to Jesus, like a friend pointing to the sunrise.
Jesus came into the world He had made. But many people did not know who He was. Some would not let Him in.
p2: But some people believed in Jesus and let Him into their hearts. To all of them, Jesus gave a gift: power to become Heavenly Father’s children.
When we believe in Jesus and follow Him, we belong in Heavenly Father’s family. Tonight, say softly, “I am Heavenly Father’s child. I belong to Him.”
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
